project.name: Course Desk
project.description: Draft bootstrapped from the repository at commit adb423c; not reviewed. Students enroll in courses and every enrollment decision is announced as a notification. NestJS API (server/, in-memory storage) plus a React page (web/). Based on README.md and the sources.

modules.name: Enrollment
modules.description: server/src/enrollment/ (EnrollmentModule). EnrollmentService calls NotificationsService.notify directly (injected via NotificationsModule import); this is a direct call, not an event, so no events or contracts are modelled.
modules.purpose: Holds the course catalog and decides, records and exposes enrollments.

modules.name: Notifications
modules.description: server/src/notifications/ (NotificationsModule). Exports NotificationsService; has no dependencies.
modules.purpose: In-memory outbox of messages to recipients, readable over HTTP.

modules.name: Web
modules.description: web/src (App.tsx, api/client.ts, components/). Depends on the other modules only through their HTTP routes under /api (api/client.ts), not through imports.
modules.purpose: Single-page React UI for enrolling and viewing the student's notifications.
